detail.longDescription: Introducing Grok Bot: AI teammates you can give real work to. Bots sign into your tools, use them like you do, and come back with finished work. Message them like a teammate. They keep context, multitask, and learn your working style on their own cloud computer. Ask Bots to run outbound overnight, code expenses from Gmail, schedule a recruiting onsite, rebalance paid ads, or ship a bug pack. They only come back when something needs your approval.
